row.evidence: Clio's pricing page lists SAML-based SSO on Signature and Elite but no SCIM, the help centre's SSO article covers Okta, Azure and custom SAML sign-in only, and the Okta catalogue app for Clio Manage is password-vaulting (SWA) only.
row.notes: Status changed partial -> none (no SCIM by absence, Clio Manage). June's 'Okta provisioning connector exists' has no first-party support: the OIN app Clio Manage is SWA only, and Clio's help centre returns no SCIM article. Plans were renamed since June (EasyStart/Essentials/Advanced/Complete at $49/$89/$119/$149 are gone): Starter 'Starting at $49/user', Core, Signature and Elite are 'Get pricing'; billing period not stated beyond 'per user per month'. SAML SSO is on Signature and Elite. The Clio Manage API v4 (OAuth 2.0, any paid account) exposes users read-only (list, get, who_am_i) plus group CRUD, so it cannot provision users. Separate enterprise product: Clio Operate (formerly ShareDo, 'Clio for Enterprise') documents a SCIM 2.0 endpoint (https://{ShareDo-url}/api/scim/{identity-provider}) with an Okta guide; it is sold separately and not priced publicly, so it is noted here and not used for the row.

scim.notes: No SCIM found for Clio Manage. Manual user admin: deactivate/reactivate in the Admin Console; no option to permanently remove a user (c7, c8).

rate_limits.text: Rate-limited per access token over a 60-second window (X-RateLimit-Limit header); 429 with Retry-After when exceeded. No number published.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial for Clio found; Clio's own SSO guide covers Azure SAML (c5).
